A separate, older row-count figure for this table differs slightly from the fresh count taken here. Reconciled: the older figure was based on a partial sample, not an exact count, and is not evidence of any activity after 2019
No available file mentions this table or the DATALOGX vendor by name. Unlike CUSTOMER_SGM_DIM, no matching landing table for this data was found either

Two columns that look like they should link to other tables by their naming carry no formal link constraint. One of the two was checked directly and every value used does successfully match its related table, with no mismatches
No invalid keys and no duplicate records exist across all 124 million rows. Every row is marked approved; no placeholder rows exist
